recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man leaning against a vintage white station wagon in a grassy field, framed by dense green trees, featuring a distinct three-part typographic header with high-contrast colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically and horizontally against the car
Typography anchored to the top edge of the frame
Horizontal car line bisects the image into upper foliage and lower grass
Color contrast between the orange title and the white/green environment
coreInvariants: Vintage white station wagon with chrome detailing
Low-angle perspective from the grass level
Muted, slightly desaturated vintage photo filter

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Man is central, medium-full shot, standing in front of the car's mid-section.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white station wagon acts as a horizontal anchor across the middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold top-left text, moves across the header, then drops to the central figure and car.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of organic negative space in the grass foreground and tree background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and earthy browns from the foliage and grass.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and chrome from the vehicle.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant burnt orange used for the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, yellow-green tint in the highlights; high value on the car body.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with color and weight variation to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment of secondary text to the right of the primary title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, professional sans-serif look.
Provides the geometric structure and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man in a light blue short-sleeve button-down shirt and dark jeans leaning against a vintage 1980s white station wagon. The car is parked in a tall grassy field with a dense wall of green trees in the background. Apply a vintage 1970s film filter with a warm, slightly desaturated color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase sans-serif text in the top left corner. The top line should be white. The second line should be a vibrant burnt orange. Add a third line of text in white to the right of the orange text in a slightly lighter weight.

verificationChecks: Is the car a vintage station wagon?
Is the text in the top left corner?
Is the color of the second line of text orange?
Is the overall mood nostalgic and acoustic?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of orange for text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
Any visible brand logos on the car
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for monolinear stroke weight in fonts
Ensure car wheels have retro chrome hubcaps
Verify the grass foreground occupies at least 25% of the frame
Confirm text does not obscure the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Vehicle + Outdoor Portrait + Geometric Header Overlay
